title: 🧪 Add tests for isOutputSafe in gemini.ts
description:
🎯 **What:** The `isOutputSafe` function inside `lib/gemini.ts` was previously untested. This PR adds a comprehensive test suite to ensure its reliability.
📊 **Coverage:** Covered happy paths (safe text), exact matches (unsafe phrases like 'kullanmayın', 'bırakın'), regex-based word boundary patterns, case-insensitivity, and substring safety.
✨ **Result:** Improved test coverage for critical safety-checking logic, ensuring the AI model outputs adhere to clinical safety regulations.
